Name: CityStats
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: CityStats, command: many)
SELECT city, mode(fare) AS usual_fare, quantile_cont(fare, [0.25, 0.75]) AS quartiles
FROM trips
GROUP BY city;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:city⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:mode(fare)⟩ AS usual_fare, ⟨c2 aliased:quantile_cont(fare, [0.25, 0.75])⟩ AS quartiles\nFROM trips\nGROUP BY city;

Name: Parsed
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Parsed, command: many)
SELECT regexp_extract(note, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 2) AS second_number, regexp_replace(note, '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS squeezed,
       strftime('%Y-%m', started_at) AS month, contains(stops, 3) AS stops_at_three, contains(tags, 'night') AS tagged,
       isfinite(started_at) AS finite, md5(raw) AS checksum
FROM trips;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:regexp_extract(note, '(\d+)-(\d+)', 2)⟩ AS second_number, ⟨c1 aliased:regexp_replace(note, '\s+', ' ', 'g')⟩ AS squeezed,
       ⟨c2 aliased:strftime('%Y-%m', started_at)⟩ AS month, ⟨c3 aliased:contains(stops, 3)⟩ AS stops_at_three, ⟨c4 aliased:contains(tags, 'night')⟩ AS tagged,
       ⟨c5 aliased:isfinite(started_at)⟩ AS finite, ⟨c6 aliased:md5(raw)⟩ AS checksum
FROM trips;

Name: Lists
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Lists, command: many)
SELECT id, range(3) AS counter, generate_series(started_at, started_at + INTERVAL 2 HOUR, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS hours,
       list_aggregate(stops, 'string_agg', '|') AS joined
FROM trips;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:range(3)⟩ AS counter, ⟨c2 aliased:generate_series(started_at, started_at + INTERVAL 2 HOUR, INTERVAL 1 HOUR)⟩ AS hours,\n       ⟨c3 aliased:list_aggregate(stops, 'string_agg', '|')⟩ AS joined\nFROM trips;

Name: Documents
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Documents, command: many)
SELECT json_extract(doc, ['$.a', '$.b']) AS parts, json_extract_string(doc, 0) AS first_text,
       json_keys(doc, '$.meta') AS meta_keys, json_array_length(doc, '$.items') AS item_count
FROM trips;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:json_extract(doc, ['$.a', '$.b'])⟩ AS parts, ⟨c1 aliased:json_extract_string(doc, 0)⟩ AS first_text,\n       ⟨c2 aliased:json_keys(doc, '$.meta')⟩ AS meta_keys, ⟨c3 aliased:json_array_length(doc, '$.items')⟩ AS item_count\nFROM trips;
